newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.363 billion yuan from 1.239 billion yuan last Friday with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.

Trading was a little more active than last Friday mainly due to the strong performance of the domestic A share markets, which resulted in some securities houses borrowing money on the interbank market, traders said.
But the head offices of most state-run banks remained on the sidelines, making trading slow, traders said.
"The market expects a lower anti-inflationary subsidy rate next month which was a factor preventing the state-run banks from trading," one trader said.
The subsidy was only 0.17 percent in April and the market expects that it could be cut to zero in May.
